reuse.why: It extends the existing isSkippedByMonthWideAction predicate used by every month-wide action, but detects the tag with its own regex instead of the shared extractTagsFromText from shared/tags.ts that the tags feature uses.

duplication.why: The skip decision stays in one predicate; the group-notes join is added to both category-reading queries (getBudgetData and getMonthWideCategories), and the tag regex is a second tag-parsing rule.

placement.why: The rule sits with the other skip rules in budget/actions.ts; tag parsing would belong in shared/tags.ts.

scope.why: Only the skip predicate, the two queries feeding it, one test and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: A one-line addition to the shared predicate is easy to own, but the bespoke regex can disagree with how the rest of the app recognises tags (e.g. '#fixed-costs', '##fixed').

bypasses_abstraction.where: actions.ts hasFixedTag: own /(^|\s)#fixed(?![\w-])/ regex instead of extractTagsFromText(...).includes('fixed') from shared/tags.ts

disguised_duplication.where: hasFixedTag re-expresses the tag-recognition rule of extractTagsFromText as a different regex rather than calling it

one_place.where: The #fixed rule is added once to isSkippedByMonthWideAction, which copyPreviousMonth (via getBudgetData rows) and all other month-wide actions (via getMonthWideCategories) use; the two queries only supply group_notes
